name: outcome-quality-enforcement
description: Enforce the highest credible quality on a consequential team outcome through reference calibration, observable success contracts, native operation, independent criticism, root-cause revision, and quality-convergence stopping. Use when an accountable lead commissions creative or ambiguous work, judges a major deliverable, sees repeated near-misses, or must decide whether more iteration is warranted. Do not use to turn routine low-risk work into ceremony.
